## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very narrow leadership concentrated in Tech (Top 5: INTC, AMD, LRCX, AMAT, ETN → Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)), and broad sector weakness across Financials, Energy and Communication (-3.62%, -5.62%, -4.16% 1W) producing mixed signals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology lead: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing limited strength: JNJ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials: ETN (1W: +11.81% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -5.03%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -17.42% | 1M: -22.35%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +14.25% | 1M: -0.83%) RECOVERY; AMAT (1W: +14.20% | 1M: -2.03%) RECOVERY; ETN (1W: +11.81% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum style.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EOG (1W: -7.74% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -8.76% | 1M: -20.93%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and Travel/Consumer Discretionary.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W moves: INTC (1W: +21.33%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +14.25%) RECOVERY. Market shows MAJOR divergence (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M such as LRCX, AMAT, ASML, SHOP, AMZN) — treat as tactical momentum, not a broad regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but leadership from semiconductors and platforms; AAPL (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: -12.90% | 1M: -21.85%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W positive amid narrow top-heavy gains; Sector breadth: Tech one of 3/11 sectors positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Weak and uneven; WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -3.75% | 1M: -2.57%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -3.62% and a lagging group — risk to cyclical exposure if weakness spreads.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive pockets holding; JNJ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -8.32%) RECOVERY. Healthcare among the three positive sectors this week, offering selective resilience.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to leading Tech names showing momentum (INTC, AMD, NVDA) while reducing exposure to the weakest pockets (WFC, TMUS, EOG) given narrow leadership and mixed breadth; style: Growth/Momentum but with caution due to concentration and divergence. Monitor major reversal candidates (LRCX, AMAT, SHOP, AMZN) for either follow-through or fade.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +10.60% | 1M: +33.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TMUS (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.72% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +4.25%) — monitor whether gains broaden beyond semis; Industrials (1W: +0.95%) on ETN strength. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.62%), Energy (1W: -5.62%) — watch for spillover into cyclicals.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +5.43% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above recent 1W highs to confirm broader Tech lift. AAPL (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND — hold of 1M trend supports sector leadership. INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND — failure to sustain post-21% surge would signal momentum fade.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SHOP (+55): SHOP (1W: +9.53% | 1M: -4.98%) RECOVERY — bullish headline aligns with short-term rally but 1M weakness shows incomplete confirmation. BA (+65): BA (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -5.00%) BELOW TREND — bullish order news but price remains below trend, divergence to watch.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (-55): AAPL (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND — negative commentary but price remains strong, a distribution risk. INTC (-50): INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND — negative headline contrasts with heavy accumulation, monitor for headline-driven pullbacks. BKNG (-50): BKNG (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -26.75%) BELOW TREND — bearish news confirms price deterioration.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given narrow Tech leadership. INTC (1W: +21.33% | 1M: +40.50%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +19.92% | 1M: +34.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing the most relative strength. Key risk is major divergence and concentration — headlines (AAPL, INTC) are diverging from price action, so watch for momentum fade.
